# The full re-run: §9.3, §10.2, §14.2, §14.3, §14.4, §5.2 and §5.5

§32.9's one open command. §14.2: the tables are "generated by the economy model under 5.8's rules — one producer of each kind per realm, pro-rata staffing, a crew assigned rather than timed — and replaced whole, never patched cell by cell", and "the full re-run publishes every milestone twice, at the bottom and the top of that band". This page is that run. A cell reads *Day a–b* across §9.6's attempt band (0.1222 to 0.1698), or one day where both edges agree.

It was reviewed adversarially before publication, claim by claim, and rebuilt on what the review found: the document's storage, entry fee, strays, school bonuses and Codex chapters are in it, and every choice the document leaves to the player is named below with what the alternative moves. Where the document is silent the tables are the model's, not the document's; read them with the choices section.

## The Codex (§14.4)

| Codex | Engaged | Never raids |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The launch 24, 510 pages | day 29 | day 76 |
| All 48, 1,200 pages | day 84–88 | never (F37) |

The launch 24 are chapters 1 and 2 (§7.6), restored cheapest first. All 48 is for a player who starts once every season's laws have shipped (§26.1: six a season): the last chapter opens at Keeper level 24, so it lands no earlier than the day that level does. Pages are one pool here, where the document keeps them per law, so both days are lower bounds.

## What the run does not carry

- tier II and III laws (they compete with restoring for pages and need Aether)
- the main Sage's levels (Insight, 11.7)
- worker bonuses (+15% school, +25% trait, 9.2)
- Aether upkeep, which gates nothing the model buys
- raids against the player: defence rewards, and the experience a foiled one might pay
- pages for meeting a law, Lab experiments that find nothing, and the Beacon (7.6); and pages are one pool, where the document keeps them per law (7.6, 10.4)
- the Dock's Stray visitor (11.8), whose rate is not stated
- strain from each law's own cost: the model uses a mean cost by rank, and stays Steady where §5.5's worked example is Humming or higher
- 27.3's catch-up discount
- time inside a day: production collected on day d is spent on day d, and what it buys produces from day d+1, which puts engaged milestones 2 to 5 days late

Each would move a day, and none is guessed into the tables.

Reproduce: `python3 -m tools.economy_model rerun`; the tables are `tools/economy_model/rerun.py` under `Config.document()`.
